phases.name: Standby
phases.job: Show the place and the assets.

phases.name: Detection
phases.job: Show exactly one thing, and where it is.

phases.name: Sizing
phases.job: Show how big, and where it is going.

phases.name: Plan
phases.job: Show the plan, every element at its proposed position.

phases.name: Authorized
phases.job: Show the same plan, restyled as committed. Nothing moves.

phases.name: Operations
phases.job: Show where everyone is, and whether the plan still holds.

phases.name: Revision
phases.job: Show the revision against the committed plan.

provenance.source: TALON spread model v3, corrected with FT-02 IR

spec.title: SPOT FIRE · 760 °C
spec.detail: FT-02 IR · 274 m ahead of the front

spec.title: ROAD CUT · ENCINAL CYN RD
spec.detail: fire on the road · 19 homes above
Speaker on · "Leave now via Encinal south"

script.note: Upper canyon (7 households) north before T+1:55

alerts.text: Update sent · 17 devices above the cut

items.title: Red Flag watch: evacuation playbooks are ready
items.body: Red Flag Warning until 18:00. I re-ran the playbooks for 3 zones against tonight's forecast (ENE 14 G24, RH 12%). Upper Encinal has one road out to the south; the north exit is Mulholland Hwy.

items.title: Pre-position E-31 at the Encinal junction?
items.body: For the Red Flag window. It cuts E-31's response to Zone 1 from 9 to 7 min. E-31 is idle on PCH east.
why: Response to Zone 1: 9 min from PCH east, 7 min from the junction
Red Flag Warning in effect until 18:00
No other engine covers the canyon mouth

items.title: FT-01 sweep: sectors 1–3 clear
items.body: No heat above 60 °C. S-7 mast nominal.

items.title: Heat detection on Trancas ridge
items.body: S-7 thermal mast · 71% match to a flame signature · 34°03.48′N 118°51.01′W. FT-01 is on its way to look, on scene in 1:04.
why: 71% match is below my confirm threshold (85%)
FT-01 can see it in 1:04; confirming blind costs nothing to wait for
Nearest home is 1211 m away

items.standing: SO-2 · verify detections in pre-cleared airspace
items.title: FT-01 retasked to the detection
items.body: Airspace box TRANCAS-2 is pre-cleared; no manned aircraft within 5 nm. Sweep paused.

items.title: The detection you dismissed is real
items.body: FT-01 IR shows active flame at 412 °C. Your dismissal stays on the record; I have opened the incident on the new evidence and copied the Regional Duty Supervisor.

items.title: Confirmed: active fire
items.body: FT-01 IR: flame front, 412 °C core, about 3.1 ac, 1198 m from the nearest home and moving WSW with the wind.

items.standing: Run card ENC-H · Red Flag dispatch level
items.title: E-32 dispatched
items.body: From Trancas Canyon, ETA 3 min.

items.standing: SO-4 · share incident intel with assigned units
items.title: Intel package sent to E-32
items.body: GPS, IR still, wind and approach via Trancas Canyon Rd.

items.standing: SO-2 · verify detections in pre-cleared airspace
items.title: FT-02 launched from dock D-2
items.body: Mapping the perimeter on a 260 m orbit. FT-01 holds the head.

items.title: Projection: west-southwest at 14 m/min
items.body: 4 ac now. Within 2 hours it reaches 9 homes, the first at T+1:46, and Encinal Canyon Rd at T+2:09.
items.basis: Spread model v3 (Rothermel + wind correction) · FT-01 IR perimeter 1 min old · RAWS 4 min old · LANDFIRE fuels

items.title: Escalate to Type 3 and request mutual aid?
items.body: Initial attack can't hold the head at 14 m/min. Within 2 hours it reaches 9 homes and the only road out of the upper canyon. Request DZ-3 and two engines from LA County (DZ-3 on scene in ~38 min).
why: Head spread 14 m/min under ENE 22 G38 mph
9 homes inside the 2-hour projection; the first burns at T+1:46
E-32 can hold a flank, not the head
Mutual aid takes ~38 min; asking later adds that delay again

items.title: Re-raised: escalation to Type 3

newEvidence: FT-02 perimeter (T+0:08): head now 17 m/min, faster than at your decision
E-32 reports spot fires across Trancas Cyn Rd

items.body: Only what is new since you held. Routed to the Regional Duty Supervisor; you are copied.

items.title: Type 3 · mutual aid requested
items.body: DZ-3 and two engines from LA County Fire. DZ-3 on scene in ~38 min.

items.title: Plan P-1: evacuate Zone 1, warn Zone 2
items.body: Adapted from playbook ENC-3 (pre-computed at T−0:42). Two changes: the wind is 8° more easterly, and Zone 2 is wider by 6 homes.
items.basis: TALON egress model · road capacity 14 veh/min one lane · 1.6 vehicles per home

gate.label: ORDER MANDATORY EVACUATION · ZONE 1 + WARNING · ZONE 2
gate.check: Alert geofence matches the zone polygons, no spill beyond 150 m
gate.onExpire: Nothing is sent. I escalate to the Regional Duty Supervisor and keep the plan current.

why: Zone 1 (37 homes) is in the fire's path; the first home is reached at T+1:46
Ordering now uses the time the fire gives us; the brief's manual process starts evacuating 38 min after the alert
Encinal Cyn Rd stays open until T+2:09, far longer than the 16 min to clear Zone 1
COA A keeps everyone on one known road with SH-12 at the hairpin; COA B sends the upper canyon along the flank
Zone 2 is outside the 2-hour projection: a warning, not an order

items.title: Alert drafted, waiting on the order
items.body: “MANDATORY EVACUATION: Encinal Canyon. Leave now. Take Encinal Cyn Rd south to PCH, then west.”

items.title: Plan P-1 lapsed without a decision
items.body: Nothing was sent. Silence is not approval: I escalated to the Regional Duty Supervisor and I keep the plan current.

items.title: Evacuation order issued on your authorization
items.body: WEA to ≈ 917 devices, reverse-911 to ≈ 172 lines. Zone 2 warned.

items.title: Executing P-1
items.body: SH-12 to the hairpin, E-31 to Zone 1 structure protection, FT-03 out of dock D-1 with speaker and strobes over Zone 1.

items.standing: SO-4 · share incident intel with assigned units
items.title: Intel package sent to all units
items.body: IR perimeter, projection, egress Route A, traffic control at the hairpin.

items.title: Zone 1 · 10% cleared
items.body: SH-12 has traffic flowing at the hairpin, 14 vehicles/min.

items.title: DZ-3 on scene
items.body: Cutting the contingency line on the south flank.

items.title: Model check passed
items.body: FT-02 perimeter matches the projection within 40 m.

items.title: Zone 1 has stalled at 84%
items.body: 7 households in the upper canyon haven't left (Sheriff door-to-door). Send FT-03 to broadcast the order over them?
why: Clearing has been flat for 12 min
Door-to-door reaches 2 homes per 5 min on that road
A broadcast reaches every home on the canyon road at once

items.title: I was wrong about Encinal Canyon Rd
items.body: FT-02 IR found a spot fire 274 m ahead of the front. I had the fire reaching the road at T+2:09; it now reaches it at T+1:55, 14 min earlier.
why: Spot fire at 34°03.31′N 118°51.99′W, 760 °C, ignited around T+1:26
Embers carried 274 m on 38 mph gusts
My model under-weights ember spotting above 35 mph; I raised the spotting term for this incident
19 homes are above the new cut point

items.title: Draft: send the upper canyon north
items.body: 7 households above the cut are still there. Route A closes at T+1:55. Route B runs north on Encinal to Mulholland Hwy: 0.9 km, 2 min, away from the head.

gate.label: UPDATE ORDER · UPPER CANYON EGRESS NORTH
gate.reach: WEA to ≈ 17 devices above the cut
gate.onExpire: The committed plan stays. I escalate to the Regional Duty Supervisor.

why: Route A closes above the hairpin at T+1:55
7 households still in the upper canyon
Driving north on Route B moves away from the head; south would drive into it
The lower canyon keeps Route A

items.title: Order updated: the upper canyon goes north
items.body: WEA to ≈ 17 devices: “Upper Encinal: go NORTH to Mulholland. The road south is closing.” FT-03 is guiding north.

items.title: Draft rejected. Route A stays primary
items.body: Your call is on the record. Route A closes at T+1:55; the 7 households must be past the cut point before then.

items.title: Encinal Canyon Rd is cut
items.body: Fire is on the road at the projected point. Route A is closed above the hairpin.

items.title: The incident log is ready for review
items.body: Every recommendation, decision, dissent and standing-order action is on the record.
